meta.note: PR #180 is this run. Carried forward from the 2026-09-17 board: every module's history is kept, this run's fixes appended to good, items it resolved moved out of pending/blocked, next replaced entirely.

modules.name: Scheduler
modules.desc: The scheduling portal on port 3000, scheduler.summitclient.io. Calendar, sessions, waitlist, clients and staff admin.

good.t: Every read pages past PostgREST's 1000-row cap
good.d: loadData() and refreshBookings() ran unbounded selects, so the Sessions tab, its count, the dashboard stat cards, the engagement leaderboard and the Create wizard's conflict pre-check silently under-reported past 1000 rows. All nine reads now page with .range() through a shared fetchAllRows() helper.

good.t: Bulk cancel is scoped to the visible rows
good.d: Nothing cleared the selection when a filter changed, so Cancel (N) could cancel sessions the user could no longer see. It now intersects with the filtered rows, as exportICS already did.

good.t: A failed recurring insert is no longer reported as success
good.d: RescheduleModal's repeat-weekly insert discarded its result and still announced 'N future sessions added'. The error is now checked and surfaced.

good.t: Calendar v2 backlog closed
good.d: The scheduler calendar rebuild and its feedback backlog were completed; TimeGrid's click-to-create target-equality guard was removed. See docs/context/product.md.

good.t: Sessions are masked for clinicians
good.d: sessions_visible() returns colleague rows with client_id and home_address null and client_masked set; lib/sessionPrivacy.ts renders from it.

good.t: proxy.ts verifies the JWT
good.d: Uses getUser() plus @summit/proxy-auth's sessionFreshness(), never getSession().

good.t: Views are gated on the sidebar's role table, not just its links
good.d: validViews accepted any ?view= id for every role, so a scheduler reached SettingsView and its Admin tab. Sidebar now exports NAV and roleAdmitsView(); index.jsx drops an unadmitted view to Dashboard.

good.t: The sidebar no longer counts cancelled sessions as booked
good.d: The footer printed bookings.length while every other count in the portal filters status !== 'cancelled' first, so the figure disagreed with the rest of the screen.

good.t: The admin page's sessions read is paged
good.d: The last unwindowed sessions read in the portal; PostgREST stops at 1000 rows without saying so. fetchAllRows() moved to lib/fetch-all-rows.ts and both pages share it.

good.t: The portal bar's scrollbar is hidden here too
good.d: This app does not import @summit/design, so .app-nav-scroll was inert while its own rule painted a 5px thumb inside the 51px bar. The two rules are now kept in step in styles/globals.css.

good.t: The mobile drawer leaves the tab order when closed
good.d: Mirrors the @summit/design fix: visibility with a delay equal to the slide, plus a reduced-motion query, since transition-duration does not touch transition-delay.

good.t: The AI matcher no longer sends a client name to Anthropic
good.d: Confirmed fixed on main and re-verified this run: the prompt carries no client name, and match.ts requires a staff role, pins model and max_tokens, and 422s a prompt containing an identity label, email or long digit run.

pending.t: Bulk cancel has no canManageSession() check
pending.d: The per-row cancel button is gated by canManageSession(), the bulk action is not, and the selection checkboxes render for colleagues' masked rows too. App-side authorization gap on a mutation; RLS still holds.

pending.t: P2: the admin role gate fails open when identity is null
pending.d: pages/admin.tsx:558 renders the staff and client management forms when appUser is null; data is empty via RLS, and fetchAll() at :126 still runs before the gate.

pending.t: P2: availability save is delete-then-insert with no result check
pending.d: index.jsx:896 and :986 wipe a client's or staff member's availability when the re-insert is refused. Same shape as the family-portal finding backed by migration 0082.

pending.t: P2: client names resolved without the privacy helper
pending.d: CalendarView's conflict message, the reschedule header and the create-wizard preview grid use a raw clients.find(); protection is sessions_visible() nulling client_id, not the app.

deferred.d: The denominator admits only completed/no_show and nothing in the app writes 'completed', so the card can read a permanent 100%. The status is schema-valid and the comment documents the current choice as deliberate, so redefining the metric is a product decision.

next.t: Make the admin role gate fail closed and move fetchAll() behind it
next.d: An excluded role's browser should not issue the query at all.

next.t: Check the availability delete-then-insert result
next.d: A refused re-insert currently leaves the grid wiped and says nothing.

next.t: Route the remaining client-name lookups through visibleClient()
next.d: Puts the app-side mask where the DB-side one already is.

neutral.d: No esbuild exists in the remote sandbox, so the suite prints SKIP and exits 0. Re-run against tsc-compiled output for a real pass line: 53 passed, 0 failed this run.

neutral.t: Keeps its own copy of the design tokens and the mobile drawer CSS
neutral.d: styles/globals.css duplicates @summit/design's drawer pattern because the app does not import that package; shared-stylesheet fixes must be mirrored here.

modules.name: Web
modules.desc: Marketing site and sign-in hub on port 3001, summitclient.io. Owns the only endpoints allowed to refresh or end the shared .summitclient.io session cookie.

good.t: The refresh retry follows the current origin
good.d: The bounded retry for a concurrent-redemption race hardcoded the production URL, stranding any non-production session. It now builds from webUrl().

good.t: The magic-link dead end explains itself
good.d: A signed-in user with no usable role was dropped on a bare /login. It now redirects with the ?error= the login page already renders.

good.t: Dead 'Reviews' nav link removed
good.d: It pointed at /#testimonials, a section that no longer exists.

good.t: globals.css is actually imported
good.d: pages/_app.tsx had no import line for as long as the file existed; confirmed still present.

good.t: Central refresh and sign-out endpoints
good.d: The only places the shared cookie is redeemed or cleared, which fixed the cross-portal refresh-token race and the sign-out that left the cookie valid.

good.t: Set-Cookie is appended rather than replaced
good.d: setAll used res.setHeader, and @supabase/auth-js writes cookies more than once per request, so a refresh batch followed by sign-out's removals lost the first -- with a chunked token that could leave the shared session valid after sign-out.

good.t: The login page no longer echoes the raw ?error= value
good.d: Every producer now sends a code and redirectErrorMessage() owns the copy; attacker-chosen text can no longer render as an official Summit message. The two app-authored sentences keep their wording.

good.t: Sign-out rejects a present-and-foreign origin
good.d: A partial mitigation, stated as such: a request with neither Origin nor Referer is still allowed because our own sign-out is a top-level <a href>. The complete fix is a POST with a token.

good.t: The password change endpoint checks the origin, the password and the error
good.d: Requires JSON, requires a known origin, enforces the 8-character floor that lived only in the page, and logs rather than renders Supabase's message. Defence-in-depth: the CSRF claim was downgraded to P3 because the session cookie is SameSite=Lax.

pending.t: safeRedirect does not reject a backslash authority
pending.d: confirm.js blocks //host but not /\host, which browsers normalize, so an offsite Location is emitted after the session cookie has been set. P1.

pending.t: The session cookie is written without Secure
pending.d: The server cookie writer never sets secure and @supabase/ssr's defaults do not either (they also set httpOnly:false); no HSTS anywhere in the repo. P1.

pending.t: P1: the browser client is a second writer of the shared session cookie
pending.d: lib/supabase.ts writes the Domain=.summitclient.io cookie via document.cookie, so it cannot be httpOnly, and login.tsx's prefill reads it back. The Secure/httpOnly fix needs that prefill replaced first.

pending.t: P1: lead PII is written with the service-role key into an untracked table
pending.d: pages/api/leads/create.js inserts full name, clinic and email with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, and no migration defines `leads`, so whether RLS is on it cannot be answered from the repo.

pending.t: P2: no CSP, X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors anywhere
pending.d: next.config.ts has no headers() block, and a repo-wide grep finds no CSP at all, so /login is framable by any site.

pending.t: P2: verifyOtp's `type` comes straight from the query string
pending.d: pages/api/auth/confirm.js:25,32 passes it with no allowlist, and any successful type lands on /update-password.

next.t: Reject backslash-authority destinations in confirm.js's safeRedirect
next.d: It blocks //host but not /\host, which browsers normalize, after the cookie is set.

next.t: Allowlist the verifyOtp `type` parameter
next.d: A fixed set instead of whatever the query string carries.

next.t: Add a headers() block with a CSP and frame-ancestors
next.d: Nothing in the repo defines one today; note the bar's inline styles need handling first.

neutral.t: Built almost entirely from inline styles
neutral.d: A className that seems inert here is usually a stylesheet-import question, not a selector bug.

modules.name: Data (clinician portal)
modules.desc: The CLINICIAN portal on port 3002, data.summitclient.io, despite the package name. Caseload, goals, session notes, supervision, the Attention screen.

good.t: The sidebar marks the current screen
good.d: PortalNav now reads usePathname() and sets aria-current plus the active class the shared stylesheet already styled. The in-app half of issue #160.

good.t: The 'Preview data' pill is double-gated on NODE_ENV
good.d: It tested the NEXT_PUBLIC_ flag alone, so a stray production flag would have labelled real PHI as fake data.

good.t: masteredAt is populated in live mode
good.d: It was built as `status === 'mastered' ? null : null` - both branches null. programs.updated_at now fills it.

good.t: Family reports show real goals and signed SOAP notes under RLS
Every API route calls requireStaff()
good.d: getUser() plus profiles.role/clinic_id, reading the correct role column.

good.t: Every clinical route confirms the client belongs to the caller's clinic
good.d: planning, decision-tree, supervision, session-plan and reports/generate all took clientId from the body while stamping the caller's clinic_id, so the RLS with-check passed for any client id. requireClientInClinic() now runs straight after requireStaff in all five.

good.t: Raw database errors no longer reach the sharing screen
good.d: visibility.ts rethrew every PostgREST message and the page printed it, which also made the role-explaining fallback unreachable. Failures now log and raise a VisibilityError written for the reader.

good.t: A failed clinical-decision write is no longer reported as committed
good.d: Both commit routes discarded the insert result and both callers ignored the response, so an RLS refusal still showed a 'Committed' badge.

good.t: The clinical query no longer declares itself PHI-free
good.d: containsPhi is caller-asserted and nothing validates it, so `false` on a free-text box decided that the text could leave for a non-Azure provider. Now true; without CLINICAL_AI_ALLOW_PHI it falls to the offline responder rather than a model.

pending.t: PHI persisted to sessionStorage
pending.d: Full SOAP bodies, ABC incidents, document drafts and assessment answers sit in the browser on shared clinic workstations; supervision notes are written there and never to supervision_notes at all.

pending.t: P2: WorkforceSection has no role gate
pending.d: Every sibling settings section checks for admin; this one renders the clinic roster and the derivation action for any clinician. Migration 0081 turns that action into a database error rather than a cross-tenant write, so the button should be gated too.

pending.t: P2: browser-side inserts take client_id from the URL
pending.d: goal-bank.ts:248,:313 and data.ts:832,:1068,:1087 stamp clinic_id from the caller's own profile while the insert policy checks only clinic and staff.

pending.t: P2: a budget update can be re-pointed at another client
pending.d: funding.ts:252 sends a caller-built row including client_id with only .eq('id', ...).

deferred.d: Nothing in the schema records that a next goal was programmed, so the definition is a product decision. Until it is made, detectMasteredWithoutNext() stays dormant and the Attention tile reads 0 even with masteredAt fixed.

next.t: Give WorkforceSection the admin gate its siblings have
next.d: Also stops a clinician hitting migration 0081's new refusal.

next.t: Add the missing client_id filters in retriever.ts and funding.ts
next.d: treatment_modifications and integrity_checks are filtered in memory; the budget update trusts a caller-supplied client_id.

next.t: Stop persisting SOAP bodies, drafts and supervision notes to sessionStorage
next.d: PHI at rest in the browser on shared clinic workstations, and supervision notes never reach their table.

neutral.t: Its layout is a Server Component
neutral.d: @summit/session is client-only, so identity work goes in a small client child.

modules.name: Client (family portal)
modules.desc: The FAMILY portal on port 3003, client.summitclient.io, used by parents and guardians. Scoped by my_family and per-child guardian permissions.

good.t: The dashboard follows the child you switched to
good.d: Only the heading and task list changed on a switch while every server-rendered number still described the previous child. A specific-child switch now refetches.

good.t: The funding statement distinguishes 'not shared' from 'none'
good.d: An RLS-empty budget read was rendered as 'No budget on file yet' - a false claim about the family's money. It now returns the no-access shape when no child grants view_billing.

good.t: Consent dates are pinned to the clinic timezone
good.d: Three timestamptz dates formatted in the server's zone on SSR and the visitor's on hydration.

good.t: proxy.ts edge guard
admin view-as cannot be forged
good.d: The viewed-child cookie is only ever matched against my_family, and the admin branch re-checks clinic and role.

good.t: Every server redirect uses the portal registry's loginUrl()
good.d: Ten getServerSideProps redirects hardcoded the production URL while proxy.ts on the same app used loginUrl(), so under next dev the two disagreed about where a signed-out visitor goes.

good.t: The statement page gates on the viewed child
good.d: It checked canForAny while querying the cookie-chosen child, so the wrong-permission-on-the-right-child case was stopped only by RLS -- which returns an empty set and renders as 'no budget on file'.

good.t: Pending change requests show for every child on the appointments page
good.d: The read was pinned to the viewed child while the sessions are family-wide, so a request filed against a sibling's session showed no pending pill and invited a duplicate.

pending.t: API routes trust request-supplied ids
pending.d: observation.ts and withdraw-consent.ts act on a body-supplied clientId/consentId with no server-side family re-derivation, unlike messages/start.ts. RLS holds today.

pending.t: session_notes read with no app-level permission check
pending.d: updates.tsx and index.tsx rely solely on session_notes_family_read.

pending.t: P2: lib/supabase-server.ts still replaces Set-Cookie
pending.d: The same defect fixed in apps/web this run; mergeSetCookie() there is the shape to copy.

pending.t: P2: the feed-token GET has no user_id filter
pending.d: pages/api/calendar/feed-token.ts:59 reads the active bearer token relying on RLS alone, while POST and DELETE both filter by user_id.

blocked.t: Uploaded documents have no version-controlled access control
blocked.d: The client-documents Storage bucket's storage.objects policies exist only as commented manual steps in migration 0036; nothing in the repo creates them, while the app uploads and signs against that bucket. P1.

blocked.t: P1: guardians can write client_availability but not read it
blocked.d: 0076 granted insert, update and delete and no SELECT, so family.tsx's grid loads empty and its delete-then-insert save wipes the scheduler's entries. Migration 0082 is written and awaiting a run.

deferred.d: announcement_reads has no write path anywhere, so every clinic notice stays pinned to the dashboard forever. The insert policy already permits a guardian's own receipt with no migration, but mark-on-mount versus mark-on-click is a product call.

Switching to Everyone clears the cookie and the server falls back to the first child, so it shows one child's numbers under a family heading. An actual aggregate needs a decision about what each figure means across siblings.

next.t: Re-derive family membership in observation.ts and withdraw-consent.ts
next.d: Both act on a request-supplied id with only RLS behind them.

next.t: Gate forms.tsx and documents.tsx on the viewed child
next.d: Same family-wide-gate-over-per-child-query shape statement.tsx just lost.

next.t: Append rather than replace Set-Cookie in lib/supabase-server.ts
next.d: Port this run's apps/web fix.

neutral.d: Anything that widens what a family can see is a security change, never a quick win.

modules.name: Employee (MySummitHR)
modules.desc: Staff self-service and the Admin console on port 3004, employee.summitclient.io. HR records, payroll, credentials, onboarding, time off.

good.t: The sidebar marks the current screen
good.d: The nav loop moved into a small client component so it can read the pathname; app/layout.tsx is a Server Component. The other half of issue #160.

good.t: The admin console shows the clinic's activity
good.d: 'Recent activity' was the last queue still reading the caller's own snapshot. It now uses a clinic-wide listRecentActivity() relying on hub_audit_read, with names resolved through directory() and a reload after each queue action.

good.t: Audit events are filed against the employee they are about
good.d: Every insert hardcoded subject = the caller, so a manager's decisions landed in the manager's history and out of reach of the clinic feed. audit() now takes a subject id.

good.t: All five admin queues are clinic-wide
good.d: Team directory, sign-offs, certificates, time-off and PD were fixed earlier; this run finished the sixth.

good.t: invite-teammate rejects an already-registered email
good.d: Returns 409 before inviteUserByEmail, closing the silent account-overwrite path CLAUDE.md still lists as open.

good.t: Schedulers reach the Admin console deliberately
good.d: Scoped exception via AdminAccessGate plus a widened hub_can_manage().

good.t: An issued certificate is filed against the employee
good.d: issueOnboardingCertificate omitted the subject from its audit() call, unlike its three siblings, so a certificate issued from the clinic-wide queue landed in the admin's own history.

good.t: A time-off decision that changes no rows now fails loudly
good.d: A PostgREST update matching nothing is not an error, and RLS grants an employee no own-row UPDATE, so cancelling one's own request gave a success toast and reverted on reload.

good.t: The Admin console's role dropdown is seeded from the real role
good.d: It was seeded from the three-value display ladder, which claimed a clinician was an admin and -- once mapped back -- would have silently demoted a scheduler, hr_admin or payroll_admin. Person now carries profiles.role, and a role this control cannot express is shown as text with role omitted from the request.

good.t: edit-teammate checks the target's current role, and invite-teammate rejects an existing profile
good.d: Both confirmed fixed on main and re-verified this run. invite-teammate's guard filters on profiles.email, a column no tracked migration creates -- see pending.

pending.t: Audit-insert policies do not pin the actor
pending.d: hub_audit_write and hr_audit_log check only clinic_id, so any clinic member can forge events under someone else's actor/subject. Migration 0012 fixed exactly this for settings_audit.

pending.t: hub_can_manage() admits the caller as their own subject
pending.d: A scheduler can self-approve their own time off, self-verify their own PD and sign off their own onboarding.

pending.t: Edge Function rate limiting fails open
pending.d: isRateLimited() returns false on a count error.

pending.t: P1: invite-teammate's duplicate guard filters on profiles.email
pending.d: No tracked migration creates that column, so the guard may match nothing. profiles is a create-table-if-not-exists baseline table; confirm against the live schema before changing either side.

pending.t: P2: provision-clinic carries a second copy of the rate-limit fail-open
pending.d: A hand-rolled isRateLimited that never reads the count query's error, on clinic and first-admin creation. Edge Function: deploys separately from the app.

pending.t: P2: the Vulnerable Sector Check upload stores only a filename
pending.d: app/documents/page.tsx:16-26 writes the name to localStorage and transmits no file, while the copy says it is verified by the office.

deferred.t: ~4.8 MB of clinic-specific assets in public/
deferred.d: Carried forward from CLAUDE.md's open list; untouched this run.

next.t: Fail isRateLimited() closed in _shared/auth.ts and drop provision-clinic's copy
next.d: Both are Edge Functions: merging a PR does not deploy them.

next.t: Pin actor = auth.uid() on hub_audit_write and hr_audit_log
next.d: Audit integrity, a PHIPA concern; 0012 fixed exactly this for settings_audit.

next.t: Exclude subject = auth.uid() from hub_can_manage()
next.d: Restores segregation of duties for time off, PD and sign-offs.

neutral.t: qa.mjs and the certificate suite test re-implemented copies
neutral.d: They cannot catch drift from the shipped code; the certificate suite does bundle the real lib/hub.ts.

modules.name: Settings
modules.desc: Org, role and user settings. localStorage in preview, the migration-0005 tables in live mode, read synchronously off an in-memory cache.

good.t: A failed write only rolls back if it is still the current value
good.d: Overlapping writes to one key - a dragged range input fires one per pointer move - could see a late-failing earlier write overwrite a newer saved value.

good.t: A failed initial load is no longer permanent
good.d: One rejection left the cache null and every read on registry defaults for the rest of the session, with an unhandled rejection at each call site. It now falls back, notifies and clears the latch.

good.t: The scheduler stops claiming an org write saved when it did not
good.d: A success toast fired synchronously beside a bare void setSetting(), so a non-admin saw 'updated' while the value rolled back.

good.t: Persists for real via Supabase
A value is validated against its declared type before it is written
good.d: setSetting persisted whatever it was handed, so a colour that reaches a CSS custom property or an off-menu select value could be stored by any caller. settingValueProblem() lives in the dependency-free value-types.ts.

good.t: Density and the accessibility preferences work in MySummitHR
good.d: That app's own app.css implements all six document attributes and nothing ever set them, so the preferences the settings screen promises 'follow you across devices' did nothing there.

good.t: The hex field honours the admin-only lock
good.d: It was the only control in the switch missing `disabled`, so a non-admin could type into it and watch the value snap back with no explanation.

good.t: The settings and identity caches clear on an auth change
good.d: Confirmed fixed on main and re-verified: all four portals now call clearIdentity()/clearSettings() on SIGNED_IN, SIGNED_OUT and USER_UPDATED, and the preview localStorage keys go with them.

pending.t: P2: 200 clinic-wide audit rows are pulled into every staff browser
pending.d: loadLive() reads settings_audit with actor UUIDs and previous/next values for any staff member; the UI blanks `who`, but the raw id reaches the client.

pending.t: P2: clearSettings() does not clear @summit/design's theme keys
pending.d: The prior user's theme and accent survive a same-tab user switch. No PHI, but the same class of bleed.

pending.t: P2: BRIGHTHR_TENANT_DEFAULT ships in the browser bundle
pending.d: It is exported from this package, which client components import, so the tenant id PR #54 moved server-side is readable anyway.

next.t: Stop reading clinic-wide settings_audit rows into the browser
next.d: Scope the read, or drop the actor id before it leaves the server.

next.t: Clear @summit/design's theme keys in clearSettings()
next.d: Finishes the sign-out cleanup the rest of the layer now does.

next.t: Stop re-exporting BRIGHTHR_TENANT_DEFAULT from a client-imported package
next.d: Undoes the leak that made PR #54's server-side move moot.

neutral.t: Reads are synchronous against a cache that starts empty
neutral.d: Anything read before initSettings() resolves gets the registry default, indistinguishably from a real value.

modules.name: Nav
modules.desc: The cross-portal AppNav bar and SupportButton, compiled from source by every app via transpilePackages. Renders from the @summit/portals registry.

good.t: The scheduler portal has a sign-out control
good.d: AppNav was mounted without signOutHref and no page consumed the signOut fn, so the portal had no way to sign out at all.

good.t: The profile avatar waits for a resolved role
good.d: profileUrl(undefined) falls through to the employee portal, so a family user clicking during the in-flight window landed somewhere ACCESS does not admit them.

good.t: Keyboard focus stays with the support panel
good.d: Opening it unmounted the trigger and dropped focus to body; the textarea is now focused on open and the trigger on close.

good.t: Sign-out always goes through signOutUrl()
good.d: No direct supabase.auth.signOut() call anywhere in the packages or the apps.

good.t: The bar already marks the active portal
good.d: Issue #160 was about the in-app sidebars, not this bar.

good.t: The Admin console's roles come from the portal registry
good.d: @summit/portals exports ADMIN_CONSOLE_ROLES and admitsAdminConsole(); the bar that offers the link and the gate that enforces it no longer keep hand-synced copies.

good.t: A whitespace-only name falls back to the person glyph
good.d: initials was '' rather than null and the render used ??, so the avatar drew an empty circle -- no initials and no glyph -- while the two style branches above already treated '' as absent.

good.t: A support address cannot smuggle mailto headers
good.d: The address is the only unencoded part of the URL and the only part that comes from the database, so a stored value ending in ?bcc=... injected headers into a message carrying the page path and the user's text. safeSupportAddress() accepts one plain address or falls back.

pending.t: An activeKey pill renders for a role ACCESS does not admit
pending.d: With role null or unrecognised the bar still shows a pill and href for the current portal. A link only - the portal's own gate still applies.

pending.t: P2: the report body embeds the real pathname
pending.d: apps/data and apps/employee pass usePathname(), so a client id in the URL is prefilled into an outbound email to a tenant-configured address. apps/client deliberately passes the route template instead.

pending.t: P2: the bar is entirely inline styles
pending.d: A CSP would need style-src 'unsafe-inline' as well as the script-src the theme script already forces.

next.t: Pass the route template, not the real pathname, from apps/data and apps/employee
next.d: Stops a client id reaching an outbound email; apps/client already does this.

next.t: Move the bar's inline styles into components.css
next.d: So a CSP need not allow style-src 'unsafe-inline'.

next.t: Validate support.devEmail on the way in
next.d: Now that it is guarded at the point of use, catch it at the point of entry too.

neutral.d: Many calc(100vh - var(--portalnav-h)) and sticky rules depend on the bar's height never changing.

modules.name: Design
modules.desc: tokens.css (the single OKLCH palette), components.css and motion, imported by every app. Apps import their own app.css after it, so a duplicate silently wins.

good.t: The hidden drawer checkbox no longer takes a desktop tab stop
good.d: opacity:0 does not remove an element from the tab order, so every page above 820px began with a phantom tab stop. It is display:none by default and re-declared inside the media block.

good.t: The mobile nav hamburger has a visible focus ring
good.d: Focus lives on the invisible checkbox and a label can never take it, so the global ring drew on nothing. It is now forwarded to the visible button.

good.t: apps/data's duplicate .shell rule removed
good.d: A byte-identical redeclaration that silently won over the shared rule.

good.t: The palette clears WCAG AA
good.d: Re-checked this run including opacity composites; lowest real text pair 4.53:1.

good.t: themeInitScript takes no external input
good.d: Its only interpolations are two module-level constants, and it compares localStorage against a fixed allowlist before setAttribute.

good.t: The sidebar no longer slides under the cross-portal bar
good.d: It was sticky at top: 0 with no z-index while AppNav is sticky at top: 0 with z-index 50 and an opaque background, so the brand block and first nav rows hid behind it on any scroll. top now offsets by --portalnav-h, as that token's own comment requires.

good.t: The mobile drawer ends at the bottom of the screen
good.d: An over-constrained fixed box drops `bottom`, so the drawer ran under the phone's URL bar and .sidebar-foot was unreachable. height: auto inside the media query.

good.t: The closed mobile drawer leaves the tab order
good.d: Off-canvas by transform alone left every link tabbable, so a phone keyboard user walked a full invisible nav. visibility with a matching delay, plus a reduced-motion query, since transition-duration does not touch transition-delay.

pending.t: applyLogoColors writes an unvalidated DB string into a custom property
pending.d: Safe today only because setProperty blocks declaration breakout and no consumer uses the var in background or url(); the file's own comment concedes the next consumer is unguarded.

pending.t: The inline theme script forces script-src 'unsafe-inline'
pending.d: Injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with no nonce exposed, and no CSP header exists anywhere in the repo.

pending.t: P2: .nav-icon composites below 3:1
pending.d: opacity 0.65 gives 2.87:1 light and 3.56:1 dark. Not a WCAG failure (aria-hidden, duplicated by its label) but the one composite under 3:1 in the palette.

blocked.d: Every authenticated PHI page in all five apps fetches CSS from a third party: viewer IP and UA to Google with no DPA, and a hostile response injects CSS into every portal. No SRI is possible on @import and consumers cannot opt out without forking. P1.

next.t: Self-host the two Google fonts
next.d: Closes the third-party CSS fetch on every authenticated PHI page in all five apps.

next.t: Expose a nonce for the inline theme script
next.d: So a CSP can drop script-src 'unsafe-inline'.

next.t: Raise .nav-icon's composited contrast above 3:1
next.d: The only pair in the palette under that line.

neutral.t: apps/scheduler keeps a duplicate of the drawer pattern
neutral.d: It does not import this package, so shared drawer fixes need mirroring in its styles/globals.css - done for both fixes this run.

neutral.t: Narrowing `:focus { outline: none }` would change nothing
neutral.d: Checked this run: tokens.css:327 and :328 have equal specificity and :focus-visible comes last, so an element that matches it already gets the ring. The proposed `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` is a no-op in any browser supporting :focus-visible.
